nodes.label: User Guide Step 4 – Dark Mode
nodes.description: User guide step 4 in dark mode. Shows the user replying '@TKT-1042 I'm on macOS 14.3. The flickering happens every 5 min.' with input field pre-filled '@TKT-1042 The issue is still happening…'. Demonstrates how users reference a ticket ID in follow-up messages to route responses back to the correct ticket thread.
